title: Ada Lovelace Day 2026: Inauguration of the Lovelace Loop
summary: NUS ACM-W and Women in Tech @ NUS Computing celebrated Ada Lovelace Day with the grand inauguration of 'Lovelace Loop'—a dedicated new SIG room and collaborative space for women in tech to connect, collaborate, and grow at NUS Computing.
upcomingSummary: Join NUS ACM-W and Women in Tech @ NUS Computing for the grand opening of our new SIG room: 'Lovelace Loop' on Ada Lovelace Day!

recapSummary: NUS ACM-W and Women in Tech @ NUS Computing celebrated Ada Lovelace Day with the grand inauguration of 'Lovelace Loop'—a dedicated new SIG room and collaborative space for women in tech to connect, collaborate, and grow at NUS Computing. The event featured a special exhibit on Ada Lovelace, interactive activities, fun quizzes, refreshments, exclusive merch, and room opening graced by SoC leadership.
recapDescription:
On 13th October 2026, the NUS ACM-W Student Chapter, in joint collaboration with Women in Tech @ NUS Computing, celebrated Ada Lovelace Day with the inauguration of our brand-new SIG room: **"Lovelace Loop"**!

### A Dedicated Space for Women in Tech

The **Lovelace Loop** is a welcoming new hub at the School of Computing created as a space for women in tech to connect, collaborate, and grow.

### Graced by SoC Leadership

We were deeply honored that the room opening was graced by the presence of distinguished School of Computing leadership:

- **Dr. Bimlesh Wadhwa**, Vice-Dean, Student Life
- **Dr. Akshay Narayan**, Assistant Dean, Student Life

Our faculty joined in celebrating this major milestone, offering warm words of encouragement on community building and fostering inclusive spaces across computing.

### Highlights & Activities

Students and faculty gathered in the new room to celebrate the occasion with an array of engaging activities:

- **Ada Lovelace Exhibit:** A special exhibit honoring the life, pioneering legacy, and visionary computing contributions of Ada Lovelace, a pioneer in computing.
- **Interactive Reflection Wall:** An interactive reflection whiteboard where students shared inspiring thoughts and personal journeys in computing.
- **Fun Quizzes & Games:** An exciting trivia competition and games celebrating women in computing and Ada Lovelace.
- **Refreshments & Merch:** Attendees enjoyed delicious refreshments and took home exclusive merch!

Thank you to everyone who joined us to celebrate Ada Lovelace Day and inaugurate the Lovelace Loop! We look forward to seeing the community make this space their own.

title: Inaugural Coffee Chat: Connecting Students and Leaders
summary: As a new chapter, NUS ACM-W hosted its inaugural Coffee Chat for Master's and PhD students alongside SoC leadership for mentorship, shared experiences, and community building.
upcomingSummary: As a new chapter, we'd love to hear from you! Join us for a casual coffee chat to meet others in the community, learn about NUS ACM-W, and help shape our upcoming events and initiatives.
upcomingDescription:
As a new chapter, we would love to hear from you. This coffee chat is a chance to:
- meet others in the community
- learn more about NUS ACM-W
- tell us about the opportunities and events you want to see
- help shape the future of our chapter

No prior involvement is needed, just come by, grab a coffee, and have a chat!
recapSummary: NUS ACM-W hosted its inaugural Coffee Chat, bringing together Master's and PhD students alongside School of Computing (SoC) leadership for an inspiring afternoon of mentorship, shared experiences, and community building.
recapDescription:
On 12th August 2026, the NUS ACM-W Student Chapter hosted its very first inaugural event, a warm and welcoming Coffee Chat, held at COM 2.

The session brought together a vibrant group of Master's and PhD students across computing disciplines to connect, converse, and build lasting peer networks.

We were deeply honored to be joined by distinguished School of Computing (SoC) leadership:
- Dr. Tulika Mitra, Dean, School of Computing
- Dr. Cristina Carbunaru, Assistant Dean, Student Life
- Dr. Bimlesh Wadhwa, Vice-Dean, Student Life

Our faculty generously shared invaluable wisdom and guidance on navigating academic life, career growth, personal well-being, and finding balance in graduate studies. It was truly inspiring to witness students and mentors find a safe, open space to exchange personal stories, challenges, and insights.

We wrapped up the afternoon filled with gratitude, shared aspirations, and a renewed commitment to support one another and grow together as a chapter. Thank you to everyone who made our inaugural event so meaningful!

title: Welcoming Freshmen at SoC Official Welcome 2026
summary: NUS ACM-W welcomed the incoming Class of 2026 at the School of Computing (SoC) Official Welcome for Freshmen at the University Cultural Centre. Our EXCO connected with enthusiastic freshmen, sharing our mission to support, celebrate, and amplify women and gender-diverse students in computing.
description:
On 5th August 2026, NUS ACM-W hosted an engaging booth at the School of Computing (SoC) Official Welcome for Freshmen held at the University Cultural Centre.

Our Executive Committee (EXCO) had a wonderful time meeting and connecting with an energetic crowd of incoming undergraduate students. Throughout the session, we introduced freshmen to NUS ACM-W's core pillars:
- **Building Community:** Fostering an inclusive, supportive network for women and gender-diverse students across computing.
- **Sharing Experiences:** Connecting students with peer support, mentorship, and inspiring community stories.
- **Amplifying Impact:** Empowering students to excel in computing research, education, and career development.

Thank you to everyone who dropped by our booth! We are thrilled to welcome the Class of 2026 to SoC and look forward to seeing you at our upcoming chapter events.
